promotions.description: ZA Bank offers a multi-currency savings account that allows customers to hold 11 different currencies, including HKD, CNY, USD, GBP, SGD, EUR, CAD, AUD, JPY, NZD, and CHF. Customers can exchange currencies 24/7 at preferred rates.

promotions.title: Free Cash Withdrawals at Visa ATMs in Hong Kong
promotions.highlight: 💳 Fee-free cash withdrawals at over 3,000 ATMs
promotions.description: ZA Bank customers can withdraw cash for free at over 3,000 Visa ATMs across Hong Kong with their ZA Card. This service provides convenient access to cash without additional fees.

promotions.title: ZA Card PowerDraw Rebate Promotion
promotions.highlight: 💰 Chance to win up to 200% rebate on spending
promotions.description: ZA Card users can participate in PowerDraw when spending with their card. Winners can receive up to 200% rebate on their purchases and also have a chance to share in a HKD 1 million prize pool through MillionTix.

promotions.title: Zero Brokerage and Custody Fees for Stock Trading
promotions.highlight: 📈 Trade stocks with 0 brokerage and 0 custody fees
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers stock trading with zero brokerage fees and zero custody fees. Platform fees are as low as USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction. Users can also enjoy the StockBack program to get free stocks after successful purchases.
promotions.cost: Platform fee as low as USD 1.99/HKD 18 per transaction

promotions.title: Zero-Fee Payment Connect for Mainland China Transfers
promotions.highlight: 🌍 Transfer to 140+ countries with zero ZA Bank fee
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers SWIFT transfers to over 140 countries and regions with zero ZA Bank fee. This service allows customers to send money globally without paying additional bank charges.

promotions.title: New Customer HKD 2,026 Reward Package and 2.5% StockBack
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Account opening process in as little as 2 minutes
promotions.description: ZA Bank enables new customers to open an account in as fast as 2 minutes. This streamlined process is available for both Hong Kong residents and visitors in Hong Kong, with zero deposit requirement.

promotions.title: Customer Referral Rewards Program for Account Opening
promotions.highlight: 👥 Earn up to HKD 90,000 by referring friends to open accounts
promotions.description: During the 9-phase promotion period, referrers can earn rewards in multiple ways: Top 20 referrers in each phase share rewards up to HKD 10,000; Cash rewards for each successful referral who deposits ≥HKD 1,000; Additional rewards for referrals who meet deposit, fund and stock holding criteria.
promotions.quota: No cap on number of referrals

promotions.title: ZA Credit New Customer Loan Approval in 90 Seconds
promotions.highlight: ⏱️ Loan approval results delivered in as fast as 90 seconds
promotions.description: New ZA Credit customers can receive loan approval results in as fast as 90 seconds. The simplified application process offers loans up to HKD 1,000,000 with annualized percentage rates as low as 1.30%.

promotions.title: ZA Bank Credit Card Statement Instalment Program with Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: ⏰ Begin repayments 30 days after loan approval
promotions.description: Customers approved for ZA Card Statement Instalment Plans enjoy a 30-day grace period before their first repayment is due. This feature provides financial flexibility for borrowers to manage their cash flow.

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary HKD 60,000 StockBack Lucky Draw
promotions.highlight: 🎰 Win up to HKD 60,000 in stock rewards
promotions.description: As part of ZA Bank's 6th anniversary celebration, customers can win stock rewards worth up to HKD 60,000 just by logging into the app. Users with ages ending in 6 (e.g., 26, 36) receive double raffle chances.

promotions.title: ZA Card StockBack 6th Anniversary 6% Cashback on Coffee
promotions.highlight: ☕ Earn 6% stock rebates when spending at coffee merchants
promotions.description: During the promotion period, customers using ZA Card at local coffee merchants can earn 6% stock rebates on qualifying transactions. Transactions must be at least HKD 10 to qualify for the rebate.
promotions.quota: Maximum rebate capped at HKD 50 per user (combined with 12% rebate)
promotions.cost: Minimum spend of HKD 10 per transaction

promotions.title: ZA Bank 24x7 Customer Service
promotions.highlight: 🕗 Available around the clock for customer support
promotions.description: ZA Bank offers 24/7 customer service support to all users. This always-on feature ensures banking assistance is available at any time, without time restrictions.

promotions.title: ZA Bank New User HKD 200 StockBack Welcome Gift
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Receive HKD 2,026 worth of investment vouchers for new accounts
promotions.description: New customers who open accounts using a referral code receive a welcome package that includes HKD 800 in fund position rebate vouchers, HKD 1,000 in stock cash rebate vouchers, a HKD 126 currency exchange discount voucher, and a HKD 100 overseas remittance cash rebate voucher.

promotions.title: ZA Card Statement Instalment Program - SURPRISE Cash Reward
promotions.highlight: 💰 Earn up to HKD 2,000 cash reward with card statement instalment plan
promotions.description: Customers who apply for a ZA Card Statement Instalment Plan using promo code [SURPRISE] can receive cash rewards up to HKD 2,000. The reward amount varies based on the loan amount (HKD 588 for loans HKD 200,000-399,999, HKD 688 for HKD 400,000-799,999, and HKD 2,000 for loans HKD 800,000+).
promotions.quota: All applicants using the promo code with qualifying loan amount and 18+ month repayment term

promotions.title: ZA Bank 6th Anniversary StockBack Leaderboard Metal Card
promotions.highlight: 💳 Exclusive metal card (worth HKD 1,000) for top 60 users weekly
promotions.description: During each of the three promotional periods, the top 60 users who accumulate the most StockBack points will receive an exclusive StockBack x ZA Card metal card valued at HKD 1,000. Points can be earned through ZA Quest tasks, StockBack x ZA Card spending, and the stock raffle promotion.

promotions.title: Zero Platform Fee on Crypto Trading for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 🪙 Enjoy 0 platform fee on crypto trading for first 90 days
promotions.description: Customers who activate crypto trading services for the first time with ZA Bank can enjoy 0 platform fee on all crypto trading transactions executed within the first 90 days after service activation, with no cap.
promotions.quota: New crypto trading service users only, limited to first 90 days after activation

promotions.title: HKD 1,000 Spending Rebate for New Customers
promotions.highlight: 💳 Zero annual fee and no hidden charges for ZA Card
promotions.description: ZA Card is offered with no annual fee and no hidden charges. The Visa debit card supports Apple Pay and Google Pay, providing a cost-effective payment solution for ZA Bank customers.
promotions.quota: Available to all eligible ZA Bank customers

promotions.title: ZA Bank Stock PowerDraw Promotion
promotions.highlight: 🎲 Get free stock rewards when purchasing stocks
promotions.description: Customers who complete stock purchase transactions during the promotion period receive one Stock PowerDraw chance, valid for 24 hours after issuance. Winners can redeem top 100 US stocks by market value using Designated Stock Redemption Coupons.
promotions.quota: Minimum platform fee requirements apply (USD 2 for US stocks, HKD 20 for HK stocks)

promotions.title: Currency Exchange Discount Voucher HKD 126
promotions.highlight: 💱 Get HKD 126 discount on currency exchange
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 126 currency exchange discount voucher as part of the new customer reward package. The voucher is valid for 30 days after receipt and can be used for eligible currency exchange transactions.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: HKD 100 Overseas Remittance Cash Rebate
promotions.highlight: 🌎 Receive HKD 100 rebate on overseas remittance
promotions.description: New customers receive a HKD 100 overseas remittance cash rebate voucher as part of the welcome package. The voucher can be applied to eligible overseas remittance transactions within 30 days of receipt.
promotions.quota: New customers only; Valid for 30 days after receipt

promotions.title: New Account Bonus - Fund Holding Rebate Vouchers
promotions.highlight: 🎁 Receive HKD 800 in fund holding rebate vouchers
promotions.description: New customers who open accounts using a referral code receive HKD 800 in fund holding rebate vouchers (one HKD 780 voucher and one HKD 20 voucher). Vouchers are valid for 30 days after receipt and can be used toward fund investments.
promotions.quota: New customers referred through the MGM program

promotions.title: Referred Friend 20% p.a. HKD Time Deposit Promotion - First Tier
promotions.highlight: 💹 Get another 20% p.a. interest rate on 7-day HKD time deposit
promotions.description: Referred customers who maintain a daily balance of at least HKD 1,000 equivalent and simultaneously hold deposits, funds and stocks within 14 days of account opening can collect another +19.9% p.a. 7-day HKD new funds time deposit booster coupon.
promotions.cost: Requires holding deposits, funds and stocks

best_for.detail: $0 commission + HKD 15 platform fee per order → total HKD 15/order. Beats ZA Bank (HKD 18 platform fee/order despite $0 commission) and PADB (charges brokerage commission per trade).
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank charges HKD 18 platform fee per order (despite $0 commission), making total cost HKD 18/order. PADB charges brokerage commission per HK trade. EleBank's HKD 15 total cost is the lowest among all 8 banks.

best_for.detail: $0 brokerage commission + USD 0.0099/share platform fee (min USD 1.99/order). EleBank ties: USD 0.0049/share commission (min $0.99) + USD 0.005/share platform (min $1.00) = USD 0.0099/share, min USD 1.99/order. PADB charges USD 0.012/share = USD 2.40 at 200 shares.
best_for.why_others_lose: EleBank effectively ties ZA Bank for US stocks (both min USD 1.99/order; USD 0.0099/share total). ZA Bank chosen as default winner for simpler $0-commission structure. PADB charges USD 0.012/share commission + $0 platform = USD 2.40 at 200 shares — more expensive than ZA Bank/EleBank.

best_for.detail: Zero platform fee on crypto trading for first 90 days for new customers, giving significant savings on cryptocurrency transactions.
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank is the only virtual bank offering a crypto trading promotion with zero platform fee. No other bank in the data shows any crypto trading promotions.

best_for.detail: StockBack x ZA Card offers 1.5% stock rebate on purchases (until 2026-06-30) plus PowerDraw chance to win up to 200% rebate on spending. Special 6% cashback on coffee for 6th anniversary (until 2026-04-21).
best_for.why_others_lose: Mox Bank offers up to 2% unlimited CashBack but ZA Bank's 1.5% stock rebate plus PowerDraw potential for up to 200% rebate and the special 6% coffee cashback make it more attractive overall with higher potential return.

best_for.detail: New User HKD 200 StockBack Welcome Gift plus HKD 2,026 worth of investment vouchers for new accounts (until 2026-05-27).
best_for.why_others_lose: Mox Bank offers up to HKD 1,500 cash rewards with 1500MOX promotion, but ZA Bank's combined HKD 200 StockBack + HKD 2,026 investment vouchers equals HKD 2,226 total value, which exceeds Mox's offer.

best_for.detail: Up to 8% off hotels and flights with Trip.com + up to 2% Unlimited CashBack (until 2026-12-31), MOXTRAVEL promotion for up to 28,500 Asia Miles (until 2026-06-30), and free Travel Pick & Go insurance add-on coverage (until 2026-05-31).
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank offers travel benefits, but Mox Bank's combination of Trip.com discounts (8%), Asia Miles earning potential (up to 28,500), and free travel insurance add-on coverage provides more comprehensive travel benefits.

best_for.detail: Instant Loan with rate as low as 1.18% plus up to HKD 10,888 cash reward (until 2026-04-30).
best_for.why_others_lose: WeLab Bank offers personal loan cash rebate up to HKD 23,888 but doesn't specify its lowest APR. EleBank offers personal loans up to 12x monthly salary but doesn't specify APR. Mox Bank explicitly states the lowest APR at 1.18%, which is the key metric for this category.

best_for.detail: WeLab Global Wallet Best Exchange Rates Guarantee ensures customers receive the best FX rates in Hong Kong for global transactions.
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank offers zero-fee payments to 140+ countries but doesn't explicitly guarantee best exchange rates. Ant Bank offers multi-currency accounts supporting HKD, RMB and USD but lacks a best rate guarantee. WeLab's explicit guarantee of best FX rates in Hong Kong provides superior value.

best_for.detail: 0% subscription fees on ALL funds with no cap until July 31, 2026. Minimum investment requirement not specified in the promotion.
best_for.why_others_lose: Mox Bank also offers 0% fund subscription fee (until 2026-06-30) but ZA Bank's promotion extends longer (until 2026-07-31). WeLab Bank offers $0 subscription fees but only on 'Featured Funds'. Ant Bank and PADB have minimum investment requirements (HKD 1 and no minimum for MMF respectively).

best_for.detail: Receive HKD 800 for each successful loan referral, up to HKD 8,000 total through the 'R-Friend Referral' Campaign (until 2026-06-30).
best_for.why_others_lose: ZA Bank offers a referral program with potential to earn up to HKD 90,000, but the per-referral amount isn't specified. WeLab Bank clearly states HKD 800 per successful loan referral, providing certainty about the reward amount per referral.

ZA Bank.focus: Investment, stock trading, and crypto with lucrative promotion combos
strengths: Zero brokerage and custody fees for stock trading
Zero platform fee for crypto trading (first 90 days)
StockBack rebate program with 1.5% stock rewards
0% fund subscription fee on ALL funds until July 2026
ZA Bank.expiring_alert: 6th Anniversary promotions ending April 21, 2026 including 6% coffee cashback and metal card for top 60 users weekly.

Mox Bank.focus: Travel benefits, cashback, and competitive loan rates
strengths: Up to 8% off hotels/flights with Trip.com + Asia Miles earning potential
Up to 2% Unlimited CashBack on all spending
Low loan APR of 1.18% with cash reward
0% fund subscription fee with low entry of HKD100/USD100
Mox Bank.expiring_alert: Tax payment promotion and Instant Loan cash reward ending April 30, 2026.
Mox Bank.vs_za_pros: Better travel benefits with Trip.com partnership and Asia Miles earning; lower loan APR at 1.18% vs. no specified rate at ZA Bank.
Mox Bank.vs_za_cons: Cashback capped at 2% vs. ZA Bank's potential 200% rebate through PowerDraw; fund subscription promotion ends earlier (June vs. July for ZA Bank).

EleBank.focus: Low-cost stock trading and personal lending
strengths: $0 commission + HKD 15 platform fee for HK stocks (total HKD 15/order — lowest among all banks)
US stock trading from USD 1.99 per trade
Personal loans up to 12x monthly salary or HKD 1,000,000
No account fees or minimum balance requirements
EleBank.expiring_alert: Visa Air Ticket Cash Rebate Promotion, but specific end date not provided.
EleBank.vs_za_pros: HK stock total cost HKD 15/order vs ZA Bank HKD 18/order — EleBank saves HKD 3 per HK trade. US stock cost tied with ZA Bank (both USD 0.0099/share, min USD 1.99).
EleBank.vs_za_cons: No crypto trading offerings; fewer promotional campaigns overall compared to ZA Bank's extensive lineup of 25 promotions; no specific stock rebate program equivalent to ZA's StockBack.

Ant Bank.focus: High-yield savings and flexible deposit options
strengths: eM+ High Yield Account with up to 2.0% p.a. interest rate
Time deposit with early withdrawal without penalty
Low minimum investment threshold for funds (HKD 1)
Multi-currency support for HKD, RMB and USD
Ant Bank.expiring_alert: SME Loan Cash Rebate Promotion and Investment Fund Transaction Fee Waiver are limited-time offers without specific end dates.
Ant Bank.vs_za_pros: High-yield savings account with 2.0% p.a. interest rate; time deposits with zero penalty for early withdrawal; lower minimum threshold for fund investments (HKD 1).
Ant Bank.vs_za_cons: Less competitive stock trading offerings compared to ZA Bank's zero commission structure; fewer promotional campaigns; no specific crypto trading services mentioned.

PADB.focus: Investment services with zero fees for money market funds
strengths: Zero subscription and redemption fees for Money Market Funds
Free real-time Level 1 market data for HK stocks
US stocks trading with zero platform fee but commission applies
No minimum balance requirement
PADB.vs_za_pros: Free real-time Level 1 market data for HK stocks; zero fees specifically for Money Market Funds.
PADB.vs_za_cons: Charges brokerage commission for HK stocks vs. ZA Bank's zero commission; higher US stock trading costs at USD 0.012/share vs. ZA Bank's USD 0.0099/share; no 0% fund subscription fee for all funds like ZA Bank.

Fusion Bank.focus: Time deposits and foreign exchange services
strengths: Flash Monday HKD Time Deposit Promotion
Foreign Exchange Time Deposit Interest Rewards
24/7 foreign exchange service
Small Change Investment starting from HKD 1
Fusion Bank.expiring_alert: Flash Monday HKD Time Deposit Promotion, Savings Interest Plus, and Foreign Exchange Time Deposit Interest Rewards are all limited-time offers without specific end dates.
Fusion Bank.vs_za_pros: Special time deposit promotions on Mondays; 24/7 foreign exchange service; low entry point for investments (HKD 1).
Fusion Bank.vs_za_cons: No stock trading promotions compared to ZA Bank's competitive offerings; fewer overall promotions (9 total vs. ZA's 25); no specified fund subscription fee waiver like ZA Bank's 0% offer.

WeLab Bank.focus: FX rates, fund investment, and loan referrals
strengths: Best Exchange Rates Guarantee for global transactions
Zero subscription and switching fees on Featured Funds
HKD 800 per successful loan referral (up to HKD 8,000)
Digital wealth advisory service
WeLab Bank.expiring_alert: Personal Loan Cash Rebate up to HKD 23,888 and R-Friend Referral Campaign ending June 30, 2026.
WeLab Bank.vs_za_pros: Best FX rates guarantee vs. ZA Bank's zero-fee payments; clear HKD 800 per referral amount vs. ZA Bank's unspecified per-referral reward; AI-powered wealth advisory service.
WeLab Bank.vs_za_cons: Zero subscription fees only on featured funds vs. ZA Bank's all funds; no specific stock or crypto trading promotions like ZA Bank offers; fewer overall promotions (7 total vs. ZA's 25).

strengths: Fee-free savings account with no minimum deposit
Free instant FPS transfers
QR payment at Hong Kong merchants
Preferential savings rate promotion
livi bank.vs_za_pros: Simpler banking structure focusing on essential services with no fees or minimum deposits.
livi bank.vs_za_cons: Much more limited promotional offerings (5 total vs. ZA's 25); no competitive stock trading, fund investment, or crypto features; lacks the variety of financial products offered by ZA Bank.
